question: List the Italian names of cards that have rulings and were illustrated by artists who also created cards available in Phyrexian. For each card, indicate whether it has sensitive content, and order the results by converted mana cost descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    fd."XCL_079" AS italian_name,
    CASE WHEN c."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL AND c."XCL_064" != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_sensitive_content
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
INNER JOIN rulings AS r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
WHERE fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'
  AND c."XCL_002" IN (
      SELECT c2."XCL_002"
      FROM cards AS c2
      INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd2 ON c2."XCL_072" = fd2."XCL_082"
      WHERE fd2."XCL_077" = 'Phyrexian'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" DESC

    fd."XCL_079" AS italian_name,
    CASE WHEN c."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL AND c."XCL_064" != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_sensitive_content
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"

WHERE fd."XCL_077" = 'Italian'

       CASE WHEN c."XCL_012" IS NOT NULL AND c."XCL_012" != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_sensitive_content
